children: Ascletis said partner Sagimet dosed the first patient in AURORA, a pivotal U.S. Phase III trial of denifanstat (ASC40) for moderate to severe acne, targeting about 800 patients including ~450 adolescents.
First U.S. Phase III patient dosed
Marks start of registrational program that can lead to NDA and potential U.S. commercialization.
Large, pivotal size increases statistical power and regulatory relevance.
Addresses a key acne demographic, potentially broadening label and market.
Regulatory pathway clarity is a key de-risking milestone for investors.
Prior positive data de-risks but must be replicated in U.S. population.

This is an early U.S. registrational step building on China Phase III and 52-week extension data. A successful readout from the ~800-patient AURORA trial and FDA acceptance of an NDA would turn this into a major catalyst.
Based on the original press release from Ascletis Pharma Inc. distributed by PR Newswire.
